description: NOC control set for PETRONAS Vitals calibration. Extraction ratio, governance separation, and gearing metrics need a base rate — a verdict without a distribution is a verdict without meaning. W-007 applied to the dashboard itself.
source_note: Public filings and sovereign fund reports, FY2024-2025 where available. Figures flagged INTERPRET or ESTIMATE where derived rather than directly observed.

cases.name: PETRONAS
cases.truth: EVALUATED — BREACHED on extraction, HOLD on governance

metrics.extraction_note: FY2025: RM32B dividend / RM45.4B PAT. FY2026: RM20B declared against unpublished PAT — UNMEASURED pending results.
metrics.governance_note: Dual-chair (PETRONAS + Gentari). Board composition unchanged. Score INTERPRET — not an IFR line item.
metrics.gearing_note: IFR audited. PRefChem consolidation may step to ~25-27% (one-time).

cases.name: Saudi Aramco
cases.truth: TRUE_NEGATIVE — extraction high but governance capacity high

metrics.extraction_note: ESTIMATE: FY2024 total dividend ~$124B against PAT ~$200B (includes performance-linked dividend). Base dividend ~$82B → ~41% of PAT. Total dividend ~62%. Sources: Aramco FY2024 results, sovereign fund reports.
metrics.governance_note: Separate Chair/CEO since 2020. Independent directors majority. PIF sovereign fund has separate governance.
metrics.gearing_note: FY2024: net debt/equity. Extremely low — cash-rich post-IPO.

cases.name: Equinor ASA
cases.truth: TRUE_NEGATIVE — low extraction, high governance, model institution

metrics.extraction_note: ESTIMATE: FY2024 dividend ~$8.5B against PAT ~$24B. Norwegian state holds 67% via Ministry of Trade. Governance arm's-length from operations. Source: Equinor FY2024 annual report.
metrics.governance_note: Oslo-listed, full IFRS. Separate Chair/CEO. Independent board majority. State ownership exercised through AGM, not direct intervention.
metrics.gearing_note: FY2024: adjusted net debt ratio. Conservative balance sheet.

cases.name: Ecopetrol SA
cases.truth: NEAR_MISS — high extraction, governance under pressure

metrics.extraction_note: ESTIMATE: Colombian state holds 88.5%. Dividend policy tied to government fiscal needs. FY2024 dividend ~$4.5B against PAT ~$7B. Source: Ecopetrol FY2024 results, Colombian fiscal reports.
metrics.governance_note: NYSE-listed but state-controlled. Board includes government ministers. CEO appointment subject to political influence.

cases.name: Pertamina
cases.truth: NEAR_MISS — high extraction, low governance separation, financial opacity

metrics.extraction_note: ESTIMATE: Pertamina is state-owned, not listed. Dividend and subsidy obligations opaque. Estimated ~55% of earnings extracted through combination of dividend + fuel subsidy burden. Source: Indonesian Ministry of Finance reports, Pertamina annual report (limited disclosure).
metrics.governance_note: Wholly state-owned. Commissioners and directors appointed by Minister of SOEs. No independent governance separation.
metrics.gearing_note: ESTIMATE: significant debt from refinery investments and fuel subsidy receivables.

cases.name: ADNOC
cases.truth: TRUE_NEGATIVE — high extraction but low debt, strong governance reforms

metrics.extraction_note: ESTIMATE: Abu Dhabi sovereign entity. Dividends not publicly disclosed in detail. Estimated ~60% based on sovereign fund inflows. Source: ADIA annual review, ADNOC limited disclosures.
metrics.governance_note: Supreme Petroleum Council governance. Recent reforms: listed ADNOC Gas, ADNOC Drilling, ADNOC Distribution. International JV partnerships create governance anchors.
metrics.gearing_note: ESTIMATE: conservatively leveraged. Strong sovereign backing.

cases.name: PTT Public Company Limited
cases.truth: NEAR_MISS — moderate extraction, listed but state-influenced, debt pressure

metrics.extraction_note: ESTIMATE: SET-listed, but Thai government holds 51.1% via Ministry of Finance. FY2024 dividend ~THB 70B against PAT ~THB 155B (~45%). Source: PTT FY2024 annual report.
metrics.governance_note: SET-listed with independent directors. But strategic decisions (energy security, fuel pricing) directed by Ministry of Energy. Partial separation.
metrics.gearing_note: ESTIMATE: net debt/equity. Significant capex pipeline (LNG, renewables).

acceptance_criteria.required: Base rate for each metric. Where does PETRONAS sit on the NOC distribution?
acceptance_criteria.extraction_ratio: PETRONAS 70.5% → rank among 7 NOCs. Is it an outlier or NOC median?
acceptance_criteria.governance_separation: PETRONAS 1.00/3 → where on the 0-3 NOC distribution?
acceptance_criteria.note: A metric without a base rate is a verdict without meaning. This panel makes the PETRONAS dashboard externally calibratable.
